info.title: BAZAR API
info.description: PostgreSQL catalog and test-isolated server authentication foundation. Runtime SMS authentication is unavailable (503) pending approved provider, keys, security policy and rollout. F9 approves one active cart/user, explicit creation, local guest cart with no merge; live activation remains blocked on production SMS/security rollout. F5 adds isolated exact-integer promotion evaluation; no real redemption/checkout activation. F6 adds isolated three-step checkout and immutable pending integration orders; no live placement/provider operation. F7 adds isolated shipping directories, selections, expiring estimates and final transaction freshness guards. Live carrier contracts/transports remain disabled. F8 adds isolated provider-neutral payment protocol/security and Ukrposhta delivery; no real financial/provider activation. F9 adds verified-session current-cart HTTP and linked isolated checkout confirmation; no production orders or paid-order claims. F12 adds isolated owned wishlist, name-only profile and opaque address operations plus explicitly policy-gated private reviews. No real PII/provider/publication activation. F13 adds isolated membership-authorized chat history, idempotent support and notification inbox contracts. No real staff, channels, files or production activation. F14 adds isolated owned cancellation/return requests, immutable lifecycle history and strictly test-only refund capacity/authenticated-event protocols. No live transitions or financial/logistics activation. F16 adds optional immutable discounted test financial snapshots and server promo/shipping metadata; production remains blocked. F17 reuses the owned F13 inbox for read/count/bulk-read/pagination and isolated browser notifications; no real channels or generic event ingestion. F20 adds explicit catalog v2 public reads with stable seller/variant ownership, binary availability, attributes/media and guarded test-only seller PATCH; legacy stock-based contracts remain separate. No production mutation/provider activation.

Runtime 503; isolated test composition only. Verified session + flow-bound CSRF required, no CORS. Evaluates one code and one product/variant line using current PostgreSQL prices/stock. Exact percentage/fixed arithmetic only; fractional minor units, over-base fixed values and multi-line allocation are policy-blocked. Does not consume usage, reserve stock/discount, change cart/order/payment or provide a payable total. No HTTP usage-claim endpoint exists.

get.description: Ordinary runtime 503. Isolated payment protocol only: realPayment/orderPaid always false; no real payable/order/refund or hosted payment route. Durable operation prepared before submission; replay never resubmits. Pending/submitting/unknown/succeeded block new attempts. Only verified server observations change outcome; cancellation must be confirmed. Verified same-origin session; POST requires flow-bound CSRF. No price, wallet token, PAN, CVV, owner ID, callback result or return URL is accepted.
